title: Selective Preference Optimization via Token-Level Reward Function Estimation
authors_zh: Kailai Yang, Zhiwei Liu, Qianqian Xie, Jimin Huang, Erxue Min, Sophia Ananiadou
paper_type_zh: token 级选择性偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 希望从既有成对数据中选择 token 级监督、降低偏好训练成本或噪声的读者。
one_line: SePO trains a small DPO oracle to select only high-value chosen tokens and low-value rejected tokens for preference optimization.
SePO 训练一个小型 DPO oracle，从偏好对中选出高价值的入选 token 与低价值的拒绝 token 进行偏好优化。
why: It turns response-level preferences into an explicit token mask that determines which supervision signals reach the target policy.
inclusion_reason: It changes which individual tokens from existing chosen and rejected responses are consumed by preference training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Conventional preference optimization treats every token in a chosen or rejected response as equally useful. This can inject large amounts of weak or noisy supervision, although a small set of extreme tokens may account for most of the preference signal. Existing selective methods often depend on expensive fine-grained labels or complicated token-selection procedures, making them difficult to apply to ordinary pairwise preference data.

The paper asks how to identify the tokens that actually drive an existing response-level preference without collecting new token annotations. It proposes to train a modest DPO oracle on a sampled subset of the target data, use the oracle/reference probability ratio as a token-level reward estimate, and train the target policy only on the selected extremes. The decision is therefore not whether to keep a response pair, but which parts of that pair should affect the objective.

传统偏好优化将入选回答或拒绝回答中的每个 token 都视为同样有用。这可能注入大量微弱或带噪的监督，尽管一小组极端 token 就可能承载了大部分偏好信号。已有的选择性方法往往依赖昂贵的细粒度标签或复杂的 token 选择过程，因此难以应用于普通的成对偏好数据。

论文要回答的是：不收集新的 token 标注，如何识别真正驱动既有回答级偏好的 token。它提出先在目标数据的一个抽样子集上训练一个适中的 DPO oracle，再使用 oracle 与参考模型的概率比作为 token 级奖励估计，并只用选出的极端 token 训练目标策略。因此，决策不再是是否保留一个回答对，而是该回答对的哪些部分应当影响训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SePO uses DPO itself as a reward estimator. Given a reference model and an oracle obtained by DPO on preference pairs, the log probability ratio for a token under the oracle and reference provides a token-level quantity proportional to the token's reward contribution. High ratios in chosen responses and low ratios in rejected responses are treated as the most discriminative evidence for the pairwise preference.

The central move is to convert that estimate into a binary training mask. The target policy no longer receives loss on every token: it receives a contrastive objective over the top-scoring chosen tokens and bottom-scoring rejected tokens. A small oracle can label a much larger policy's training data because it identifies useful positions rather than directly generating the target response. This gives a concrete route from coarse preferences to sparse, model-consumable supervision.

SePO 将 DPO 本身作为奖励估计器。给定一个参考模型和一个在偏好对上经过 DPO 得到的 oracle，某个 token 在 oracle 与参考模型下的对数概率比，提供了一个与该 token 奖励贡献成比例的 token 级量。入选回答中的高比值和拒绝回答中的低比值，被视为区分该成对偏好的最有力证据。

核心动作是将这一估计转化为二元训练掩码。目标策略不再在每个 token 上接收损失，而是在最高分的入选 token 和最低分的拒绝 token 上接收对比目标。一个小型 oracle 可以为远大于它的策略模型标注训练数据，因为它识别的是有用位置，而不是直接生成目标回答。这为从粗粒度偏好转化为稀疏、可被模型消费的监督提供了一条具体路径。

title: Method
方法
html:
The procedure has three stages. First, a reference model is obtained through supervised fine-tuning on chosen responses from a moderate random subset. DPO on that subset produces an oracle model. For every token in the full target preference set, SePO computes the log probability of the oracle divided by the reference, conditioned on the prompt and preceding tokens. The paper argues that this score estimates a decomposed token-level reward under its stated assumptions.

Second, within each chosen response SePO retains the top k percent scoring tokens, and within each rejected response it retains the bottom k percent. Third, it optimizes a length-normalized contrastive objective using only these masked token likelihoods. The main experiments use 30 percent selection. The authors also test weak-to-strong variants: a small oracle selects tokens for a stronger policy, or a high-quality oracle selects useful positions from weak, out-of-distribution preference data.

该过程包含三个阶段。首先，在一个中等规模的随机子集的入选回答上进行监督微调，得到参考模型。再在该子集上进行 DPO，得到 oracle 模型。对于完整目标偏好集中的每个 token，SePO 计算在给定提示和前序 token 时，oracle 概率除以参考模型概率的对数。论文认为，在其陈述的假设下，这个分数估计了被分解后的 token 级奖励。

第二步，在每条入选回答中 SePO 保留得分最高的前 k%，在每条拒绝回答中保留得分最低的前 k%。第三步，它只使用这些被掩码 token 的似然，优化一个长度归一化的对比目标。主实验使用 30% 的选择比例。作者还测试了弱到强变体：一个小型 oracle 为更强策略选择 token，或一个高质量 oracle 从弱的、分布外偏好数据中选择有用位置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across Arena-Hard, AlpacaEval 2.0, and MT-Bench, the main setting selects only 30 percent of response tokens. The paper reports that this reduces GPU training hours by 39.94 to 62.34 percent relative to comparison methods while outperforming the principal response-level and token-level baselines on most tested policy models. For LLaMA-3-Base-8B, SePO reaches 25.0 percent Arena-Hard win rate and 25.6 percent length-controlled AlpacaEval win rate, compared with 20.6 and 21.78 for SparsePO and 15.9 and 18.2 for DPO.

The controls connect performance to selection quality rather than sparsity alone. Randomly selecting the same share of tokens sharply lowers results; on LLaMA-3-Base-8B it yields 6.2 percent Arena-Hard and 10.6 percent length-controlled AlpacaEval win rates. The study also reports that a TinyLLaMA-1.1B or Pythia-1B oracle can guide substantially larger policies, and examines out-of-distribution HH-RLHF supervision to show selective masks can reduce over-optimization on weaker data.

在 Arena-Hard、AlpacaEval 2.0 和 MT-Bench 上，主设置只选择 30% 的回答 token。论文报告，相对于比较方法，这使 GPU 训练时长减少 39.94% 至 62.34%，同时在多数被测试策略模型上超过主要的回答级和 token 级基线。对于 LLaMA-3-Base-8B，SePO 的 Arena-Hard 胜率为 25.0%，长度控制的 AlpacaEval 胜率为 25.6%，而 SparsePO 分别为 20.6% 和 21.78%，DPO 分别为 15.9% 和 18.2%。

对照实验将性能与选择质量而非仅仅稀疏性联系起来。随机选择相同份额的 token 会显著降低结果；在 LLaMA-3-Base-8B 上，它的 Arena-Hard 胜率为 6.2%，长度控制的 AlpacaEval 胜率为 10.6%。研究还报告，一个 TinyLLaMA-1.1B 或 Pythia-1B oracle 可以引导大得多的策略模型，并检验了分布外 HH-RLHF 监督，以表明选择性掩码能够减少在较弱数据上的过度优化。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new contribution is a record-level transformation from response pair to token-masked pair. Rather than asking a reward model to label every action or training on all response text indiscriminately, SePO derives a reusable token score from an ordinary DPO oracle and uses it to decide which tokens become the actual learning surface. This changes the supervision granularity of existing preference data without requiring a new human annotation channel.

The work also separates weak supervision from weak generation. A smaller oracle need not produce a better response than the target policy; it only needs to rank which positions carry useful preference evidence. That distinction supports the reported weak-to-strong setting and distinguishes the method from a direct distillation pipeline. The paper's random-mask control makes the key claim falsifiable: the gain is attributed to the estimated reward ranking, not simply to training on fewer tokens.

新的贡献是将回答对在记录层面转化为带 token 掩码的回答对。SePO 既不要求奖励模型标注每个动作，也不对所有回答文本不加区分地训练，而是从普通 DPO oracle 中导出可复用的 token 分数，并用它决定哪些 token 成为实际学习表面。这在不需要新的人工标注通道的情况下，改变了既有偏好数据的监督粒度。

该工作还将弱监督与弱生成区分开来。一个较小的 oracle 不必生成比目标策略更好的回答；它只需要判断哪些位置承载有用的偏好证据。这一区分支持文中报告的弱到强设置，并将该方法与直接蒸馏流程区分开来。论文的随机掩码对照使关键主张可以被证伪：增益被归因于估计的奖励排序，而不是仅仅来自训练更少 token。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The key-token fraction is empirically set and may need to change substantially across data distributions and target policies; the paper leaves automatic ratio selection open. Evidence does not extend to stronger policy models such as 70B systems, and the token estimator inherits any coverage or preference defects in its sampled oracle-training data. The evaluation relies on public instruction-following benchmarks judged by GPT-4o and does not provide a dedicated human audit showing that every selected mask corresponds to a human-interpretable preference rationale.
关键 token 的比例通过经验设定，并且可能需要随数据分布和目标策略发生较大变化；论文将自动选择比例的问题留作开放问题。证据没有扩展到 70B 系统等更强的策略模型，token 估计器也会继承其抽样 oracle 训练数据中的任何覆盖缺陷或偏好缺陷。评测依赖由 GPT-4o 判定的公开指令跟随基准，并没有提供专门的人工审计来显示每个选出的掩码都对应人类可解释的偏好理由。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use SePO when pairwise preference data is available but full-response optimization is expensive or suspected to be noisy. The recipe is especially useful for studying which parts of a response are actually consumed by an alignment objective, for reusing an existing preference set with a smaller training budget, or for testing whether a modest model can identify useful learning positions for a larger policy. Before deployment, validate the token-mask distribution, selection fraction, judge sensitivity, and licenses of the underlying pairs rather than assuming the reported 30 percent is universal.
当已经拥有成对偏好数据，但全回答优化成本过高或被怀疑带有噪声时，可以使用 SePO。该方案尤其适合研究回答中的哪些部分实际被对齐目标消费、以更小训练预算复用既有偏好集，或测试一个适中的模型能否为更大策略识别有用学习位置。在部署之前，应验证 token 掩码分布、选择比例、评审器敏感性和底层样本对的许可，而不是假设文中报告的 30% 具有普适性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Theorems 1 and 2 with Sections 3.1–3.2 before using the reported efficiency numbers: the method depends on both the DPO-based reward interpretation and a sampled oracle's ability to represent the target distribution. Then compare SePO with SePO-rand in Table 1, which establishes that masking alone is insufficient. For a replication, record the oracle/reference pair, sampled subset fraction, selected-token ratios for chosen and rejected responses, and exact handling of tokenization; those choices define the supervision records that the target model actually sees.

在使用报告的效率数值之前，应将定理 1 和定理 2 与第 3.1 至 3.2 节结合阅读：该方法依赖于基于 DPO 的奖励解释，以及抽样 oracle 表示目标分布的能力。接着比较表 1 中的 SePO 与 SePO-rand，这证明仅有掩码并不足够。若要复现，应记录 oracle、参考模型组合，抽样子集比例，入选和拒绝回答各自的 token 选择比例，以及 token 化的精确处理方式；这些选择定义了目标模型实际看到的监督记录。
